INSERT INTO approvals (id, org_id, identity_id, action_summary, permission_keys,
                                status, token, expires_at, current_resolver_identity_id,
                                execution_mode)
         VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 'gated then queued', '{}', 'allowed', $4,
                 now() + interval '1 hour', $3, 'async')
